tools.name: search_ecuador
tools.description: Searches datasets, orgs, procedures, regulations, contracts, and risk events all at once.
tools.long_description: Unified search across Ecuador open data, trámites, regulations, contracts and risk events. Use this as the first step for broad questions. Then drill down with get_dataset_info, query_resource_data, get_tramite_info, get_regulacion_info, get_contrato_info or search_eventos_riesgo.

tools.name: lookup_ubicacion
tools.description: Provinces, cantons, and parishes (INEC code, region, population).
tools.long_description: Look up Ecuador DPA geography: provinces, cantons and parroquias (INEC codes). - nivel='provincia' | 'canton' | 'parroquia' | 'auto' - For parroquias, filter with canton= and/or provincia= (recommended)

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search datasets by keyword. Supports filtering by category.

params.name: category
params.description: Optional category filter (e.g. "sal" for Salud, "edu" for Educación). Use list_categories to see all available categories.

params.name: sort
params.description: `relevance` (default, CKAN's own ranking) or `recent` (newest first by metadata_modified; works without a query to discover new or freshly refreshed datasets).

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Search for datasets on Ecuador's open data portal (www.datosabiertos.gob.ec). This is the starting point for exploring government data from 98+ public institutions. Use short, specific queries in Spanish for best results. Typical workflow: search_datasets → list_dataset_resources → preview_resource_data

tools.name: get_dataset_info
tools.description: Detailed dataset metadata: title, description, organization, tags, license, dates.

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Get detailed metadata about a specific dataset from Ecuador's open data portal. Returns title, description, organization, tags, resource count, creation/update dates, license, update frequency, the publisher's source URL (where the entity keeps the authoritative data, if any), and any custom metadata fields the publisher added.

tools.name: list_dataset_resources
tools.description: Lists all files (resources) in a dataset with format, size, URL, and creation/modification dates.

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: List all resources (files) in a dataset with their metadata. Returns resource ID, title, format, size, download URL, and creation/ last-modified dates for each file. The dates let you tell whether a dataset's files are periodic snapshots (compare last_modified across resources to find the most recent one) before reading any of them. Also flags groups of resources whose names look like a periodic series (e.g. weekly files) — that's only a hint that they might need combining or picking the latest one; it does not tell you which, since that depends on the dataset (some periodic files replace previous ones, others complement them). Next step: use preview_resource_data on a CSV resource to see its contents, or use get_resource_info for detailed metadata.

tools.name: get_resource_info
tools.description: Detailed information about a specific file.

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Get detailed information about a specific resource (file) from Ecuador's open data portal. Returns format, size, MIME type, download URL, and dataset association. For CSV files, you can then use preview_resource_data to see the actual data.

tools.name: preview_resource_data
tools.description: Preview CSV/TSV, JSON/GeoJSON, Excel (XLS/XLSX/XLSB), ODS or a ZIP/tar.gz wrapping a CSV as a table (max 5 MB).

params.name: resource_id
params.description: The resource UUID (get it from list_dataset_resources)

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of data rows to preview (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Download and preview a resource from Ecuador's open data portal. Supports CSV/TSV, JSON/GeoJSON, Excel (XLS/XLSX/XLSB), ODS, and .zip or .tar.gz wrapping a CSV/TSV/TXT. Returns the first N rows as a formatted table so the model can inspect data without a local download. Geometry/WKT columns are dropped from the table (they can be tens of KB per cell); CSV columns in European decimal notation (7.760,2) are normalized to standard notation (7760.2). Max download size: 5 MB. For large tabular DataStore resources prefer query_resource_data.

tools.name: download_resource
tools.description: Raw base64 bytes of a resource (max 5 MB) for formats preview_resource_data can't parse (.rar or unrecognized).

params.name: resource_id
params.description: The resource UUID (get it from list_dataset_resources)

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Download a resource's raw bytes from Ecuador's open data portal, base64-encoded. Use this for formats preview_resource_data can't parse into a table (.rar or anything unrecognized) — it fetches the file as-is instead of trying to read it. Max size: 5 MB (same cap as preview_resource_data). Larger files come back with an error and the direct URL instead, since they'd be too big to embed in a response. Call with format="json" to get the actual file content — the default format="text" only confirms the download and never includes content_base64.

tools.name: query_resource_data
tools.description: Tabular query via the CKAN DataStore (filters, text, pagination) without downloading the file.

params.name: query
params.description: Optional full-text search across datastore fields

params.name: filters_json
params.description: Optional JSON object of exact field filters, e.g. '{"provincia":"Pichincha"}'

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of records to return (default 20, max 100)

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Query a tabular resource via CKAN DataStore without downloading the full file. Prefer this over preview_resource_data when the resource is in the DataStore (most CSV resources on the portal). Supports full-text query, JSON filters, sorting and pagination.

tools.name: detect_series_pattern
tools.description: For datasets that publish one file per period: tells whether each new file replaces the previous ones (cumulative) or complements them (incremental).

params.name: resource_id_new
params.description: Optional -- newer resource ID to compare (auto-detected from the dataset's periodic-name group if omitted)

params.name: resource_id_old
params.description: Optional -- older resource ID to compare (auto-detected if omitted). Both resource_id_new/resource_id_old must be given together, or neither.

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: When a dataset publishes one file per period (weekly/monthly), it's not always clear whether each new file replaces the previous ones (cumulative -- only the newest file matters) or complements them (incremental -- every file must be combined). Downloads the two most recent resources from the periodic-name group list_dataset_resources already detects, finds a date/period-like column by header name (fecha, mes, año, periodo, semana, ...), and compares which period values appear in both files. High overlap → cumulative; near-zero overlap → incremental; if no period column is found or the overlap is ambiguous, returns indeterminado rather than guessing. A heuristic over a sample of up to 500 rows per file -- confirm with preview_resource_data if the result is close to the threshold.

tools.name: search_tramites
tools.description: Search Ecuadorian government procedures (ID card, passport, RUC, driver's license, etc.).

params.name: query
params.description: Keywords to filter results (e.g. "RUC", "inscripción RUC persona natural"). Each word must appear in the trámite name or description.

params.name: institution_id
params.description: Institution ID (strongly recommended for relevant results)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-based, default: 1). Ignored when query is provided (all pages are searched automatically).

tools.long_description: Search for government procedures (trámites) on Ecuador's official portal gob.ec. Best approach: provide an institution_id to get that institution's trámites. Add a query to filter results by keyword (filters by name and description). When query is provided with institution_id, ALL pages of that institution's trámites are fetched and filtered, so you always get the most relevant results. Common institution IDs: - "8" = SRI (Servicio de Rentas Internas) — impuestos, RUC, facturación - "23" = Registro Civil — cédula, partidas de nacimiento - "62" = ANT — licencias de conducir, matriculación vehicular - "16" = Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores — pasaportes, apostilla - "5" = IESS — seguro social, pensiones, fondos de reserva Use list_instituciones to find more institution IDs.

tools.name: get_tramite_info
tools.description: Requirements, beneficiaries, cost and responsible institution of one trámite.
tools.long_description: Get detailed information about a specific government procedure (trámite). Returns the procedure name, description, requirements, beneficiaries, cost, and the institution responsible. Get the tramite_id from search_tramites.

tools.name: get_tramite_estadisticas
tools.description: Monthly usage/complaint transparency series for one trámite, since 2021.
tools.long_description: Monthly usage and complaint series (atenciones/quejas) for one specific trámite. Different from get_tramite_info: this is how many people were actually attended each month, and how many complaints were filed, since gob.ec started publishing this (mid-2021). Get tramite_id from search_tramites. There is no bulk endpoint -- this fetches one trámite's series at a time (currently a few dozen months, no pagination needed).

tools.name: list_instituciones
tools.description: List Ecuador's public institutions.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-based, default: 1, only used without query)

tools.long_description: List or search public institutions registered on Ecuador's gob.ec portal. If a query is provided, searches across all institutions by name or acronym. Without a query, returns a paginated list. Common institutions: SRI (ID: 8), Registro Civil (ID: 23), ANT (ID: 62), Cancillería (ID: 16), IESS (ID: 5), Ministerio de Salud, INEC, BCE.

tools.name: get_institucion_info
tools.description: Detail of an institution (sector, website, description).
tools.long_description: Get detailed information about a public institution registered on gob.ec. Returns name, acronym, sector, description, website and portal URL. Get the institucion_id from list_instituciones. Common IDs: SRI=8, IESS=5, Registro Civil=23, ANT=62, Cancillería=16.

tools.name: search_anda
tools.description: Search INEC's ANDA catalog of surveys and censuses (NADA/IHSN). Indicates whether each survey has downloadable microdata.
tools.long_description: Search INEC's ANDA catalog (anda.inec.gob.ec) of surveys and censuses. ANDA runs on NADA (World Bank/IHSN), separate from datosabiertos.gob.ec. It catalogs 437+ INEC surveys/censuses with metadata (title, year, authoring entity). Not every entry has downloadable microdata — many are aggregate-only publications (e.g. price indices); each result says so. Follow up with get_anda_survey_info(idno) for full metadata on one survey.

tools.name: get_anda_survey_info
tools.description: Full metadata for an ANDA survey: summary, variables, confidentiality, and contact.
tools.long_description: Get full metadata for one ANDA (INEC) survey/census by its idno. Get the idno from search_anda results — it's the string identifier (e.g. "IDD-ECU-INEC-CGTPE-DECON-ENESEM-2023-v1.3"), not the numeric id. Returns scope/abstract, variable count, whether microdata is actually downloadable, confidentiality terms, and a contact email for requesting restricted data when it isn't.

tools.name: download_anda_microdata
tools.description: Direct download links for an ANDA survey's microdata files.
tools.long_description: Get direct download links for an ANDA survey's microdata files. Automates ANDA's one-click usage-terms step (research/statistical use only, no re-identifying respondents, cite the source — see get_anda_survey_info for the full text) to reveal the file list. Check get_anda_survey_info first: aggregate-only surveys (microdatos_disponibles false) have no files here. Returns direct URLs, not the file contents — the files are typically multi-MB ZIPs (SPSS .sav inside), too large to embed in a tool result. Download them with the returned URL.

tools.name: search_indicadores_bce
tools.description: Search the Central Bank of Ecuador's statistical catalog (monetary/financial, public finance, external sector, real sector).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against the group's description, its section/subsection, and its individual series labels (accent-insensitive)

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set

tools.long_description: Search the Banco Central del Ecuador (BCE) statistical catalog. Covers monetary/financial statistics, public finances, external sector (foreign trade), and real sector (GDP, employment/ unemployment, consumer confidence, oil production, cement production, and more) — each result is an indicator group (id_grupo) whose time series data you fetch with get_indicador_bce. Some groups hold a single series, others dozens under a broader title (e.g. "desempleo" is a series inside the "mercado laboral" group, not a group of its own — matched here too, not just group titles). Does NOT cover Ecuador's own inflation (CPI) or poverty statistics — those are INEC's domain, try search_anda instead. First call after the cache expires (24h) takes ~10-15s: matching against series names, not just group titles, means fetching every group's metadata (~78 groups) once to build the search index. Cached after that.

tools.name: get_indicador_bce
tools.description: Time series for an indicator by id_grupo: configurable period, frequency, and unit (defaults set per group).

params.name: desde
params.description: Start period as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the earliest available period for the chosen frequency.

params.name: hasta
params.description: End period as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest available period for the chosen frequency.

params.name: frecuencia
params.description: Semanal | Mensual | Trimestral | Anual. Defaults to the group's first available frequency.

params.name: unidad
params.description: Varies by group (e.g. "Millones de USD", "Indice", "Porcentaje"). Defaults to the first one available for the chosen frequency.

tools.long_description: Time series data for one Banco Central del Ecuador (BCE) indicator group. Use search_indicadores_bce first to find the id_grupo. Frequency and unit vary by group (e.g. "Mensual"/"Millones de USD" for money supply, "Trimestral"/"Porcentaje" for GDP growth) — omit them to get the group's default, or check the error message for the valid options if you guess wrong.

tools.name: search_companias
tools.description: Search the Superintendency of Companies' directory (226k+, by name/RUC, province, legal status).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against company name or RUC (accent-insensitive)

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set

tools.long_description: Search Ecuador's company registry (Superintendencia de Compañías). Covers 226k+ companies with legal status, incorporation date, legal representative, registered capital, economic activity (CIIU) and address. Source is a daily-refreshed government export, cached up to 6h server-side — the first call after the cache expires can take ~30-40s to download and parse (~35 MB, 226k rows).

tools.name: get_compania_info
tools.description: Full company profile by RUC: legal representative, subscribed capital, CIIU code, address.
tools.long_description: Get full registry details for a company by RUC (Superintendencia de Compañías). Returns legal status, incorporation date, legal representative, registered capital, economic activity (CIIU), address and last balance-sheet year. Use search_companias first if you don't have the exact RUC.

tools.name: search_ranking
tools.description: Rank/filter companies by financial indicators (year, CIIU, any column); requires the local financial database build.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Column to sort ascending by (e.g. "posicion_general", "activos", "roe"). Falls back to posicion_general if unknown.

params.name: descending
params.description: Sort descending if true (default false = ascending); use it for top-N by a column such as roe. posicion_general is already ascending (1 = best), so leave it false when sorting by it.

tools.long_description: Rank/filter Supercías companies by financial indicators for a fiscal year. Filter by year and/or CIIU level-1 economic activity (single letter, e.g. "C" for manufacturing), sorted by any indicator column (defaults to the dataset's own precomputed posicion_general). Each result includes the company's nombre/ruc alongside its financials. Covers the last five fiscal years in the local build, not the full history. Use get_financials for one company's full detail, or get_compania_info for legal/registry data (address, legal representative, etc.).

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: A company's financial history by filing number or RUC: revenue, assets, equity, ~38 ratios (liquidity, leverage, profitability).

params.name: expediente_or_ruc
params.description: The company's Supercías "expediente" number (from search_companias/get_compania_info) or its 13-digit RUC.

tools.long_description: Get a company's financial history from Supercías balance-sheet filings. Returns revenue, assets, equity, profit, employee count, and financial ratios (liquidity, leverage, profitability) per fiscal year. Covers the last five fiscal years in the local build (see metadatos.base_local for its build date and year range), not the full history back to 2008. Complements get_compania_info, which has legal/registry data but no financials.

tools.name: search_auditores
tools.description: Search the registry of authorized external auditors (1,447 firms/individuals, by name or ID, province).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against auditor name or identificación (RUC/cédula), accent-insensitive

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set

tools.long_description: Search Ecuador's registry of authorized external auditors (Superintendencia de Compañías). Covers the 1,447 firms/individuals licensed to act as external auditors, with their authorization resolution number/date and contact details. Source is a daily-refreshed government export, cached up to 6h server-side.

tools.name: get_auditor_info
tools.description: Full profile of an external auditor by ID: authorization resolution, nationality, address, contact.
tools.long_description: Get full registry details for an authorized external auditor by identificación (Superintendencia de Compañías). Returns authorization resolution number/date, nationality, address and contact details. Use search_auditores first if you don't have the exact identificación (RUC/cédula).

tools.name: search_regulaciones
tools.description: Search/list regulations on gob.ec (with Official Register reference).

params.name: page
params.description: Page number when query is empty (1-based)

tools.long_description: Search or list regulations published on Ecuador's gob.ec portal. Includes agreements, regulations and related norms with Registro Oficial references when available. With a query, scans several pages client-side (the API has no native search). Without a query, returns a paginated list.

tools.name: get_regulacion_info
tools.description: Detail of a regulation, plus a link to the PDF.
tools.long_description: Get detailed information about a regulation published on gob.ec. Returns type, Registro Oficial reference, description and PDF/archivo URL when available. Get the regulacion_id from search_regulaciones.

tools.name: search_contratos
tools.description: Search public procurement processes (SERCOP/OCDS).
tools.long_description: Search Ecuador public procurement procedures (SERCOP / OCDS open data). Useful for journalists, researchers and citizens looking for contracts, tenders, buyers or suppliers. Requires a keyword of at least 3 characters. Year defaults to the current calendar year and falls back to prior years when year=0. Results are cached ~30 minutes; on 429 the client cools down.

tools.name: get_contrato_info
tools.description: Full OCDS record: buyer, tender, awards, contracts.
tools.long_description: Get the full OCDS record for a public procurement procedure (SERCOP). Returns buyer, tender, awards, contracts and useful links when available. Get the ocid from search_contratos.

tools.name: search_eventos_riesgo
tools.description: COE emergency/risk events (landslides, floods, etc.).
tools.long_description: Search emergency/risk events from Ecuador's SGR COE (Gestión de Riesgos). Returns recent recorded events such as landslides, floods, structural damage, with province/canton, status (Seguimiento/Cierre), impacts and description. Data comes from the public ArcGIS COE2 service (cached ~5 minutes).

tools.name: list_sat_tsunami
tools.description: Tsunami early-warning stations.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max stations to include in the response (default 30)

tools.long_description: List tsunami early-warning SAT stations published by SGR (Gestión de Riesgos). Returns station codes and coordinates from the public SAT MapServer.

tools.name: search_sismos
tools.description: Recent earthquakes from the Geophysical Institute's (IG-EPN) catalog: magnitude, depth, location, and review status.

params.name: dias
params.description: Only events from the last N days (0 = all available)

tools.long_description: Search recent earthquakes in Ecuador from the Instituto Geofísico (IG-EPN). Returns the IG-EPN seismic catalog feed: magnitude, depth, coordinates, local/UTC time, review status and nearest-place description, with a link to each event page. Data is cached ~2 minutes.

tools.name: search_sgr_sitreps
tools.description: Historical archive of SGR adverse-event dossiers (2016-2026).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the event's titulo, estado, or descripcion, e.g. "terremoto", "en curso", "manabi". Empty returns all events.

tools.long_description: Lists SGR's SITREP ("Informes de Situación") archive of adverse-event dossiers, 2016-2026. A different source from search_eventos_riesgo, which reads a live ArcGIS snapshot of current events only. Lists about 54 multi-year dossiers — earthquakes, forest-fire seasons, rainy seasons, landslides, volcanic activity — each with a status and its own page. Follow up with get_sgr_sitrep_archivos(url).

tools.name: get_sgr_sitrep_archivos
tools.description: SITREP PDF reports for one SGR adverse event.

params.name: evento_url
params.description: An event URL from search_sgr_sitreps' url field (must be on gestionderiesgos.gob.ec).

tools.long_description: Lists the SITREP PDF report links published on one SGR adverse-event page. Returns each report's grupo (the page's own section heading, e.g. national vs. provincial vs. cantonal), título, and direct PDF URL. A long-running event can carry 700+ PDFs; a closed single-incident event usually has far fewer.

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Search across 98+ institutions that publish data (INEC, SRI, BCE, MSP, etc.).

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Search for public institutions that publish data on Ecuador's open data portal. There are 98+ organizations including INEC, SRI, Ministerio de Salud, BCE, etc.

tools.name: get_organization_info
tools.description: Info about an organization, with datasets filterable by text.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against each dataset's title. Empty returns all datasets.

tools.long_description: Get detailed information about a public institution and its published datasets — the main way to browse a CKAN organization's full package list, including large ones with no dedicated tool of their own (e.g. "sri-servicio-de-rentas-internas" —127 packages—, "ministerio-de-economia-y-finanzas" —97—, "ieps" —106—, "cosede" —88—, "ipaip" —70—, "mag" —69—; get the exact slug from search_organizations first if unsure). format=json always returns every dataset; format=text caps display and tells you how many more exist — use query to narrow a large organization down instead of scrolling past the cap.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Topic categories with dataset counts.

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: List all thematic categories of Ecuador's open data portal. Categories include: Salud, Educación, Economía y Finanzas, Seguridad y Defensa, Anticorrupción, Ambiente y Agua, Transporte, Turismo, and more. Each category shows the number of datasets it contains. Use the category 'name' field as the 'category' parameter in search_datasets to filter results by topic.

tools.name: get_category_info
tools.description: Detail of a category and sample datasets.

params.name: include_datasets
params.description: Include sample datasets in the category (default True)

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec), "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), "latacunga" (datosabiertos.latacunga.gob.ec, independent municipal portal), or "iadb" (data.iadb.org, IADB's open-data portal — NOT Ecuador-only, a regional/global catalog: Latin Macro Watch and World Bank/IADB indicators)

tools.long_description: Get details for a thematic category (CKAN group) on Ecuador's open data portal. Use list_categories first to discover valid category IDs (the 'name' field, e.g. 'salud', 'educacion', 'economia-y-finanzas').

tools.name: get_bce_iem_table
tools.description: Inspect one official XLSX table from the latest BCE IEM bulletin.

params.name: desde
params.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or a month-year label.

params.name: hasta
params.description: Latest period to include, same formats as desde.

params.name: boletin_numero
params.description: Past bulletin number from search_bce_iem(historico=true); 0 means the latest.

tools.long_description: Inspect one official XLSX table from the latest BCE IEM bulletin. Get table_id from search_bce_iem. Tables with the common BCE layout (periods across columns and variables down rows) return structured, date-filterable series. Other layouts return a faithful preview rather than silently guessing columns. Always includes the BCE file and bulletin URLs for verification. Pass boletin_numero to retrieve a historical version returned by search_bce_iem(historico=true).

tools.name: get_bce_indicador_diario
tools.description: Fetch one BCE daily/monthly indicator's time series (e.g. Riesgo País).

params.name: codigo
params.description: A "Código Variable Dinámica" from that same archivo.

params.name: ultimos_n
params.description: Most recent N observations when no date range is given.

tools.long_description: Fetch one BCE daily/monthly indicator's time series (e.g. Riesgo País), bounded to a window — never the full series (some run 7,000+ observations). Get archivo/codigo from list_catalogo(fuente='bce_diarios') first — a codigo only means one thing within its own archivo. Without desde/hasta, returns the most recent ultimos_n observations (capped at 366). With desde/hasta (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), returns that date range instead, also capped at 366 rows (most recent within the range if it's larger). The response always includes rango_completo (the series' true full date range and row count) so the window returned is never mistaken for the whole series. Each point in "datos" has "valor" (one number) for almost every indicator, except Inflación (datos_ipc.json), which has no single value — its points carry "valores": {"Mensual":..., "Anual":..., "Acumulada":...} instead.

tools.name: search_bce_iem
tools.description: Search individual Excel tables in the BCE's latest IEM bulletin.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against table titles and sections (accent-insensitive). Empty lists every table.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set.

params.name: historico
params.description: Also search past monthly bulletins, not just the latest.

params.name: desde_anio
params.description: Earliest bulletin year to search (implies historico).

params.name: hasta_anio
params.description: Latest bulletin year to search (implies historico).

params.name: guardar_catalogo
params.description: Save the full assembled catalog under IEM_CATALOG_DIR.

params.name: hash_archivos
params.description: Download each discovered XLSX and report its SHA-256 (operator audit; slow).

params.name: max_hash_archivos
params.description: Cap on files hashed when hash_archivos is set.

tools.long_description: Search individual Excel tables in the BCE's latest IEM bulletin. Use this for detailed BCE tables not conveniently available through search_indicadores_bce/BCEData: trade by country, debt, public finance by government level, oil, GDP breakdowns, and more. It lists tables from the current monthly bulletin; use get_bce_iem_table with a returned table_id to inspect one official XLSX file. Set historico=true (or provide desde_anio/hasta_anio) to search across all matching monthly bulletin pages; this is slower on the first call because the archive pages must be read. Set guardar_catalogo=true to persist the complete catalog assembled by this search under IEM_CATALOG_DIR (or data/iem_catalog_snapshots by default). Pagination still keeps the MCP response bounded. Set hash_archivos=true for an operator-style SHA-256 audit of the discovered XLSX files. This downloads complete files, so it is deliberately opt-in and bounded by max_hash_archivos.

tools.name: search_bce_calendario
tools.description: BCE's scheduled statistical-publication calendar.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against the publication name or its observations note (accent-insensitive). Empty matches all.

params.name: categoria
params.description: Exact category filter (accent-insensitive), e.g. "cuentas nacionales", "balanza de pagos y comercio exterior".

params.name: desde
params.description: Restrict to release date >= this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: hasta
params.description: Restrict to release date <= this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: solo_proximas
params.description: If true, only releases scheduled today or later.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set.

tools.long_description: Search BCE's own statistical publication calendar — scheduled release dates for IEM, Cuentas Nacionales, IMAEC, balance of payments, and more, each with category, periodicity, reference period, and a direct link to the publication's page. Distinct from search_archivos(fuente='bce_publicaciones') (a rolling window of ~30 already-published items, no future dates): this is BCE's own forward-looking release schedule for the full calendar year.

tools.name: search_bce_paginas
tools.description: BCE publication pages with file archives: indices or national accounts.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the page's title, category or id. Empty returns all pages.

tools.long_description: Lists the BCE's publication pages for one catalog: indices (sector bulletins, price and confidence indices, FX, balance of payments; some back to 2004) or cuentas_nacionales (annual, quarterly, regional accounts, input-output, IMAEC). Next: get_bce_pagina_archivos(pagina_id).

tools.name: get_bce_pagina_archivos
tools.description: Files of one BCE publication page, most recent first.

params.name: anio
params.description: Only for catalogo="indices": restrict to one year (0 = all).

params.name: max_archivos
params.description: Cap on returned files, 1-200 (most recent first); use anio to reach further back.

tools.long_description: Reads the file list of one BCE page (pagina_id from search_bce_paginas): title, URL and format. For indices it also carries year and period (quarter, month or week). Returns links, not contents.

tools.name: get_inec_estadistica_files
tools.description: List the direct file links published on one INEC statistical topic page.

params.name: url
params.description: A topic URL from search_inec_estadisticas's "url" field (must be on ecuadorencifras.gob.ec)

tools.long_description: List the direct file links published on one INEC statistical topic page. Get the url from search_inec_estadisticas. Returns technical bulletins, methodology, and historical series as direct PDF/XLSX/CSV/ZIP links — not the file contents. Use read_pdf on a .pdf link, or download it yourself for tabular formats.

tools.name: get_inec_publicacion_archivos
tools.description: List the direct file links (PDF/XLSX/CSV/ZIP) embedded in one INEC publication found via search_inec_publicaciones.

params.name: post
params.description: Either the numeric "id" from search_inec_publicaciones, or the publication's full ecuadorencifras.gob.ec URL.

tools.long_description: List the direct file links (PDF/XLSX/CSV/ZIP) embedded in one INEC publication found via search_inec_publicaciones.

tools.name: search_biinec_extras
tools.description: Check INEC's BIINEC ("Banco de Datos Abiertos") for data not found in search_anda or search_inec_estadisticas.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against the registry's name/description (accent-insensitive). Empty returns the full curated list.

tools.long_description: Check INEC's BIINEC ("Banco de Datos Abiertos") for data not found in search_anda or search_inec_estadisticas. Last resort for INEC queries: BIINEC (aplicaciones3.ecuadorencifras.gob.ec) mostly duplicates ANDA and Ecuador en Cifras, so this does NOT scrape or search BIINEC live — it's a small, manually-verified list of the handful of registries confirmed to exist only there (environmental/administrative modules, e.g. hazardous waste in health facilities, ENEMDU/ECV environmental modules). If your query matches nothing here, that does NOT mean BIINEC has nothing — it means it wasn't worth automating; search the site's own search box directly instead.

tools.name: search_inec_estadisticas
tools.description: Search INEC's statistical topic pages (ecuadorencifras.gob.ec).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against the topic name (accent-insensitive), e.g. "precios", "empleo", "pobreza". Empty returns all topics.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set

tools.long_description: Search INEC's statistical topic pages (ecuadorencifras.gob.ec). Covers ~75 topics INEC publishes (IPC, ENEMDU, ENSANUT, pobreza, comercio exterior, cuentas nacionales, construcción, censos...), separate from both search_datasets (CKAN) and search_anda (INEC's microdata archive). This is where the actual published aggregate series live — technical bulletins, methodology, and full historical series in Excel/CSV — for operations that ANDA only catalogs as metadata with no downloadable microdata (e.g. price indices). Follow up with get_inec_estadistica_files(url) for one topic's file links.

tools.name: search_inec_publicaciones
tools.description: Search every post INEC has published on Ecuador en Cifras, via its public WordPress REST API -- always current, newest first.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against title/content (e.g. "ENEMDU anual 2025", "inflación julio", "censo"). Empty returns the most recent posts regardless of topic.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched set.

tools.long_description: Search every post INEC has published on Ecuador en Cifras, via its public WordPress REST API -- always current, newest first. Complements search_inec_estadisticas: that tool's topic pages are curated landing pages that can go stale for months or years even while INEC keeps publishing the same operation (confirmed live: ENEMDU's old "Empleo" topic page stopped at April 2023 while INEC kept releasing it monthly under dated posts this tool finds). Use this tool for "what's the latest bulletin/release for X" questions. Use search_inec_estadisticas/get_inec_estadistica_files instead when you want one operation's fixed overview page rather than a specific dated release. Follow up with get_inec_publicacion_archivos(id) for one publication's file links.

tools.name: get_sri_ruc_info
tools.description: Look up a taxpayer's public record by RUC in the SRI.
tools.long_description: Look up a taxpayer's public record by RUC in the SRI. Returns legal name, status, type, economic activity, registration dates, and registered public establishments. Does not return individual tax declarations or amounts.

tools.name: search_sri_ruc
tools.description: Search SRI's RUC registry by legal name or trade name (partial text), without needing the exact RUC upfront.

params.name: razon_social
params.description: Text to search for (minimum 4 characters), e.g. "BANANERA"

params.name: max_resultados
params.description: How many full-detail results to return (max 100)

tools.long_description: Search SRI's RUC registry by legal name or trade name (partial text), without needing the exact RUC upfront. Complements get_sri_ruc_info (which requires the exact RUC) for the "I know the company name, not its RUC" case. Each result includes status, taxpayer type, régimen, economic activity, legal representatives, and whether it's a withholding agent/special taxpayer/ghost taxpayer — no declarations or individual tax amounts. The SRI caps this search at 100 matches per query; if total_reportado comes back as 100, there may be more taxpayers than are actually being returned — use more specific text to narrow it down.

tools.name: get_contraloria_informe
tools.description: Download and preview one Contraloría document (Datos Abiertos or Plan Anual de Control).

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of data rows to preview (default: 50, max: 200)

tools.long_description: Download and preview one Contraloría document (Datos Abiertos or Plan Anual de Control). Get informe_id from list_catalogo(fuente='contraloria'). Quarterly "Datos Abiertos" documents return one row per audit report approved that quarter, across every public institution in the country. "Plan Anual de Control" documents are PDFs (one per year); this returns their metadata and points you at read_pdf instead of a table.

tools.name: get_sipa_resumen_indicadores
tools.description: Monthly "Resumen de Indicadores" PDFs from SIPA (Ministry of Agriculture), by year.
tools.long_description: Lists the direct monthly PDF links for one year of SIPA's "Resumen de Indicadores" report, reached from the Ministry of Agriculture's "Indicadores Sectoriales" dashboard page. Confirmed live 2018-2026; each year is a separate page and filename conventions differ across years. Other items on the same dashboard are Tableau Server embeds or JS flipbooks with no direct file — none of those are covered by this tool.

category: CENACE, SUT, IG-EPN, and power cuts

tools.name: get_cenace_tablero
tools.description: Fetch one tablero (tab) of CENACE's live grid-operations snapshot (Ecuador's national electricity operator) — generation mix and demand, always as-of-now.
tools.long_description: Fetch one tablero (tab) of CENACE's live grid-operations snapshot (Ecuador's national electricity operator) — generation mix and demand, always as-of-now. Tableros: - produccion_tiempo_real: current instant. - demanda_tiempo_real: current instant, plus a per-distributor (empresa eléctrica/CNEL) MW breakdown. - operativa_diaria: yesterday's full day total. - acumulada_mensual: month-to-date total (MWh). - acumulada_anual: year-to-date total (GWh). Each returns "resumen" (produccion total/exportación/importación/ hidráulica/térmica/renovable no convencional, or the demand equivalent). There is no historical query here — CENACE's page has no date picker, only these 5 as-of-now views.

tools.name: get_informe_igepn
tools.description: Download and extract text from one IG-EPN report found via search_informes_igepn.

params.name: nombre
params.description: Exact report name from search_informes_igepn (e.g. "Informe Diario 2022-071")

params.name: volcan
params.description: Volcano name, only needed to disambiguate a duplicate nombre

params.name: grupo
params.description: "sismico" | "volcanico" | "" (both) -- same value used to find it

params.name: anio
params.description: Report year (0 = current year) -- same value used to find it

params.name: pages
params.description: Page range, 1-indexed (e.g. "3", "1-5"). Empty = whole document, capped at 20 pages/call

tools.long_description: Download and extract text from one IG-EPN report found via search_informes_igepn. IG-EPN has no stable per-report URL (each download is a session-bound form submit), so this re-locates the report by exact name/year/group and streams its PDF directly -- pass `volcan` to disambiguate when two reports share the same name on the same day (happens for volcanic daily reports).

tools.name: get_sut_indicador_schema
tools.description: List the queryable columns/measures/date-levels for one SUT Power BI dashboard, discovered from the report's own layout definition (every visual's underlying query), not by guessing.
tools.long_description: List the queryable columns/measures/date-levels for one SUT Power BI dashboard, discovered from the report's own layout definition (every visual's underlying query), not by guessing. A field like "public contratos.nombre_padre_activ_econ_empresa" is a plain column usable in query_sut_indicador's campos or filtros; one ending in "[medida]" is an aggregate measure (only valid in campos, never filtros); one ending in "[Año]"/"[Mes]" is a date-hierarchy level. denuncias_publico and encuentra_empleo use an older report layout where visuals don't expose their query this way at all — their fields come from a small manually-captured set instead (recovered by driving the live dashboard and reading the queries it actually sent), not from this automatic discovery, but they show up here the same as any other field.

tools.name: query_sut_indicador
tools.description: Run a live query against one SUT Power BI dashboard's underlying data model — any combination of its fields, e.g. month and industry together.

params.name: campos
params.description: Field labels exactly as returned by get_sut_indicador_schema.

params.name: filtros
params.description: Optional {campo: valor} equality filters, plain columns only.

params.name: limite
params.description: Row cap applied server-side by the query itself.

tools.long_description: Run a live query against one SUT Power BI dashboard's underlying data model — any combination of its fields, e.g. month AND industry together for "contratos" (a real monthly time series since 2015 by CIIU industry, province, gender, contract status — none of this is in the ministerio-del-trabajo CKAN datasets, which are a single current-snapshot stock count with no time dimension). Get valid campos from get_sut_indicador_schema(indicador) first — an unrecognized field name raises an error naming the tool to call instead of guessing. filtros only accepts plain-column fields (not "[medida]"/hierarchy-level fields) and matches exact text equality, e.g. {"public contratos.Estado contrato": "Vigente"}. Rows can run into the thousands for a wide breakdown (e.g. every month x every industry) — narrow with filtros or fewer campos rather than raising limite past what's actually needed; format "json" is exact but still subject to the same limite cap.

tools.name: search_informes_igepn
tools.description: Search the IG-EPN PDF report archive (Instituto Geofísico): daily/weekly/monthly/special seismic bulletins, volcanic "IG Al Instante" alerts, field/annual reports, etc.
tools.long_description: Search the IG-EPN PDF report archive (Instituto Geofísico): daily/weekly/monthly/special seismic bulletins, volcanic "IG Al Instante" alerts, field/annual reports, etc. Different from search_sismos, which reads the raw earthquake catalog feed -- this searches the narrative/PDF report archive instead. Use get_informe_igepn afterwards to download and read one report's text.

tools.name: get_energia_ecuador_snapshot
tools.description: 2024 blackout schedules from energia-ecuador.com, recovered from the Wayback Machine.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched against canton or sectors, accent-insensitive. Empty returns all rows.

tools.long_description: Recovers, via the Wayback Machine, the national blackout-schedule aggregator the Ministry of Energy ran during the 2024 crisis (the domain is now dead). Only the Empresa Eléctrica Quito page was archived: a frozen 2024-04-24 snapshot of Pichincha's rotation by province, canton, and sector. Not a live series.

tools.name: search_cortes
tools.description: Scheduled power-cut PDFs of one utility (EEQ or CentroSur).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the file's period, date, title or URL, e.g. "noviembre", "2024-10". Empty returns all files.

tools.long_description: Lists one electricity distributor's archive of scheduled power-cut PDFs: eeq (Quito, 2023-2024 blackout crises) or centrosur (Azuay, Cañar, Morona Santiago, 2023 on). Regional, not national. Next: get_cortes_horarios with a file's `archivo`.

tools.name: get_cortes_horarios
tools.description: Parse one power-cut PDF into rows: date, time blocks, location and sectors.

params.name: archivo
params.description: The file's `archivo` from search_cortes (EEQ: slug or URL; CentroSur: PDF URL).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against location and sectors, e.g. "La Floresta", "Gualaceo". Empty returns every row.

tools.long_description: Parses one scheduled power-cut PDF (`archivo` from search_cortes) into rows with page, date, time blocks without power, sectors and the utility's location fields (EEQ: substation; CentroSur: province/canton/zone). query filters by place.

tools.name: get_arconel_reporte
tools.description: Run one ARCONEL report (e.g. "Balance Energía" for a year) and return its rows.

params.name: tipo
params.description: Report name as listed by list_catalogo(fuente='arconel') (accent/case-insensitive), e.g. "Balance Energía", "Pérdidas".

params.name: mes
params.description: 1-12, only for report types with a month filter; others already break down by month.

tools.long_description: Runs one report from ARCONEL's builder and returns its rows, e.g. "Balance Energía" 2023: energy received, sold and lost per month and distributor, with technical and non-technical loss percentages. Slow (about 50 rows per page): max_paginas caps the work and `completo` says whether everything was read.

tools.name: investigate_dataset
tools.description: One-shot research shortcut: search for a dataset, list its resources, and preview the most promising one's actual data -- the search_datasets -> list_dataset_resources -> preview_resource_data workflow in a single call, for the common case of "find me data about X and show me what's in it"

params.name: source
params.description: "nacional" (default), "cuenca" (Cuenca municipal portal), "latacunga" (Latacunga municipal portal), or "iadb" (IADB's portal, not Ecuador-only)

params.name: preview_rows
params.description: Data rows to preview from the chosen resource (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.long_description: One-shot research shortcut: search for a dataset, list its resources, and preview the most promising one's actual data -- the search_datasets -> list_dataset_resources -> preview_resource_data workflow in a single call, for the common case of "find me data about X and show me what's in it". Picks the top-ranked search result and, among its resources, the first one in a format this server can actually parse into a table (CSV/JSON/XLS/XLSX/XLSB/ODS/ZIP/TARGZ), skipping unreadable ones (.rar, unrecognized formats) rather than previewing whichever resource happens to be listed first. Not a replacement for the individual tools: if the top search result isn't the right dataset, or you need a specific resource within it, use search_datasets/list_dataset_resources/ preview_resource_data directly instead of re-running this.

tools.name: list_zip_contents
tools.description: List a .zip archive's member files (name, size) from a direct URL, without downloading the archive.

params.name: url
params.description: Direct URL to a .zip file (from another tool's result, e.g. get_inec_publicacion_archivos, search_archivos).

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the member list.

tools.long_description: List a .zip archive's member files (name, size) from a direct URL, without downloading the archive. Reads only the End Of Central Directory record and the central directory via HTTP Range requests, so it works for archives far larger than the 5 MB preview_resource_data/download_resource cap -- e.g. INEC or censo microdata ZIPs of multiple hundred MB. Requires the server to honor Range requests; fails with a clear error otherwise. Does not support ZIP64 archives. Listing names is cheap this way, but previewing a specific member's rows is not (still needs decompressing from that member's offset onward) -- this tool only lists metadata.

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF document at a direct URL.

params.name: url
params.description: Direct URL to the PDF file

params.name: pages
params.description: Page range, 1-indexed (e.g. "3", "1-5", "1,4,9"). Empty means the whole document, still capped at 20 pages per call.

tools.long_description: Extract text from a PDF document at a direct URL. Useful for PDFs linked from other tools' results, e.g. get_regulacion_info's Registro Oficial file, or a dataset resource that turned out to be a PDF bulletin instead of a tabular file. No OCR: a scanned PDF with no embedded text layer will come back empty. Max download size: 5 MB (larger files return an explicit error instead of a partial read -- PDFs can't be parsed from a truncated download); max 20 pages extracted per call (call again with a different `pages` range for the rest).

tools.name: get_iess_archivos
tools.description: Documents in one IESS collection.

params.name: coleccion
params.description: "boletines" (annual, 1978-2024 confirmed), "estudios_actuariales" (per fund, only a handful of years), or "informes_auditoria" (2007-2026 confirmed, by year).

params.name: anio
params.description: Filter to one year. Required for "informes_auditoria". Optional for the other two collections.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against título and, where available, descripción/grupo.

tools.long_description: Lists one IESS document collection's actual documents, each resolved to a direct download URL, título, and formato. Call list_catalogo(fuente='iess') first to see what years/counts each collection has.

tools.name: get_certificado_cumplimiento_patronal
tools.description: Checks whether an employer is current on IESS contributions.
tools.long_description: Queries the IESS's public Employer Obligations Compliance Certificate (no login) and reports whether the employer has contributions in arrears. If the certificate text can't be parsed, the status is reported as NO DETERMINADO (undetermined). It does not return employee counts: the IESS doesn't publish that per company; use the n_empleados field from get_financials/search_ranking (self-reported to Supercías).

tools.name: get_aviso_aeronautico
tools.description: Live aeronautical notices from DGAC: METAR, NOTAM or SIGMET for Ecuador.

params.name: designador
params.description: ICAO code of the aerodrome, e.g. SEQM (Quito), SEGU (Guayaquil), SECU (Cuenca). Required for metar and notam; ignored by sigmet.

tools.long_description: Queries DGAC's IFIS site (ais.aviacioncivil.gob.ec), public with no login. metar: latest METAR/SPECI reports of an aerodrome (type, UTC time, raw ICAO text; usually hourly). notam: active NOTAMs of an aerodrome with series number (e.g. A1784/26), the Q)/A)/B)/C)/D)/E) text and DGAC's decoded fields; for the fixed data sheet use get_aip_aerodromo. sigmet: active SIGMETs (volcanic ash, turbulence, icing, storms) for Ecuador's single FIR (SEFG); zero results means none are active. An unknown designador returns an empty result, not an error.

tools.name: list_aip_aerodromos
tools.description: Aerodromes/helipads with a published AIP data sheet.
tools.long_description: Lists the ICAO designators and names of every aerodrome/helipad with a published AIP AD 2.x page, from DGAC's public eAIP — no login required. Use get_aip_aerodromo with one of these designators to fetch its full data sheet (coordinates, runway, operating hours, fees, ATS frequencies, etc.).

tools.name: get_aip_aerodromo
tools.description: Full AIP AD 2.x data sheet for an Ecuadorian aerodrome.

params.name: designador
params.description: ICAO code of the aerodrome/helipad, e.g. SEQM (Quito), SEGU (Guayaquil), SECU (Cuenca).

tools.long_description: Fetches the published AIP AD 2.x data sheet for an Ecuadorian aerodrome or helipad, from DGAC's public eAIP — no login required. Returns every numbered field the AIP publishes, grouped by ICAO Annex 15 subsection: location and administrative data, operating hours, rescue-and-firefighting services, apron/taxiway data, radio navigation aids, runway physical characteristics, declared distances, lighting, flight procedures, and supplementary information. Use list_aip_aerodromos to see which designators are published.

tools.name: search_infomies_bases_mensuales
tools.description: Monthly infoMIES databases (economic and social inclusion).

params.name: serie
params.description: "anc" (non-contributory insurance / economic inclusion) or "is" (SIIMIES users / social inclusion).

params.name: anio
params.description: Specific year to fetch, e.g. 2024. Omit to fetch every known year and aggregate (multiple cold-cache requests).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the file's label, year, or URL, e.g. "julio", "2023". Empty returns all files for the selected year(s).

tools.long_description: Lists infoMIES's (statistics portal of the former MIES) monthly database files for one program: "anc" or "is". Richer than this project's existing CKAN coverage for the same programs, which only has quarterly snapshots. Confirmed live: only the current year has one file per month so far; every closed year (2019-2025) has exactly one file, the December/year-end snapshot. Files are .rar (outside this project's supported-format list) — only metadata and the direct URL are returned.

tools.name: search_infomies_boletines_zonales
tools.description: infoMIES zonal bulletins, by zone or consolidated by year.

params.name: zona
params.description: Required for modo="zonal": one of "zona-1-bz".."zona-9-bz". Ignored for modo="consolidado". Leave empty with modo="zonal" to get the list of valid zone keys.

params.name: anio
params.description: Specific year to fetch. For "zonal", omit to fetch every year found (typically 2017-2021). For "consolidado", omit to fetch 2021-2026.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the file's label, year, or URL.

tools.long_description: Lists infoMIES's zonal bulletin files. Two distinct series live under this name: modo="zonal" (default), the original "Boletín Zonal" series (one .rar per zone per month), discontinued (2017-2021, nothing since); modo="consolidado", the newer "Reporte Boletines Zonales" successor (one consolidated XLSX per year, 2021-2026, still being updated). Both return metadata and direct URLs only — the .rar files are additionally outside this project's supported-format list.

tools.name: search_cepalstat_indicadores
tools.description: Search CEPAL/ECLAC's CEPALSTAT regional indicator catalog.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the indicator's name or its thematic-area breadcrumb, e.g. "poblacion", "pobreza", "comercio exterior". Empty returns the full catalog (large — prefer a query).

tools.long_description: Search CEPALSTAT (CEPAL/ECLAC's public statistics API) for an indicator by name — 2,059 indicators across Demográficos y sociales, Económicos, Ambientales, and Temas transversales (incluye los ODS). NOT an Ecuador-only source: CEPALSTAT is CEPAL's regional catalog for all of Latin America and the Caribbean. Use this to find the indicator_id, then get_cepalstat_indicador to fetch Ecuador's observations specifically.

tools.name: get_cepalstat_indicador
tools.description: One CEPALSTAT indicator's observations, filtered to a country (Ecuador by default).

params.name: pais
params.description: Country to filter to (accent-insensitive, e.g. "Ecuador", "Peru"). Empty string fetches every country the indicator covers — can be a few MB for a rich indicator.

tools.long_description: Fetch one CEPALSTAT indicator's observations, filtered to one country (Ecuador by default) so the response stays small — CEPAL's raw API returns every country in the region (and often the world) per indicator otherwise, confirmed live at ~2.5 MB unfiltered vs. ~85 KB filtered to one country. Each returned record decodes CEPALSTAT's raw dimension ids into readable labels (e.g. "Sexo": "Mujeres", "Años": "1975") using that same indicator's own dimension catalog — not every indicator has the same dimensions.

tools.name: get_serie_internacional
tools.description: International series with Ecuador data: World Bank WDI indicators, IRENA electricity capacity and generation, and XM's Colombia-Ecuador power flows.

params.name: indicador
params.description: wdi only: WDI code. Empty with query searches the catalog.

params.name: query
params.description: wdi only: catalog search text (English), used when indicador is empty.

params.name: pais
params.description: wdi/irena: ISO3 code (irena also accepts the English name). Ignored by xm. Default ECU.

params.name: desde
params.description: Start: a year (YYYY) for wdi/irena, a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for xm.

params.name: hasta
params.description: End, same format as desde. xm allows at most 366 days.

params.name: tecnologia
params.description: irena only: technology label substring (solar, hydro, Total Renewable...). Empty returns all.

params.name: tipo
params.description: irena only: generacion (GWh), capacidad (MW) or ambos.

params.name: conexion
params.description: irena only: All, On-grid or Off-grid.

params.name: sentido
params.description: xm only: exportaciones (Colombia to Ecuador) or importaciones (Ecuador to Colombia).

params.name: limit
params.description: WDI catalog search only: maximum indicators (1-200).

tools.long_description: Fetches a series from an international source, filtered to Ecuador. wdi: World Bank World Development Indicators (1,400+ yearly series); with indicador (e.g. EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS access to electricity) returns the series, with only query (English) searches the catalog; years without a value are dropped and counted. irena: IRENASTAT installed capacity (MW) and generation (GWh) by technology, 2000 on, on/off-grid. xm: XM's hourly energy on the Colombia-Ecuador interconnection, summed by day or month since 2003; needs desde and hasta (at most 366 days); days without flow show as 0 GWh, so the October 2024 suspension appears as zeros.

tools.name: search_archivos
tools.description: File links published by one institution (SRI, MEF, SENAE, INEC, MINEDEC, etc.).

params.name: fuente
params.description: Catalog to search; see the list of sources.

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against each file's title and source fields. Empty returns all files.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset over the matched files.

params.name: formato
params.description: Optional exact file format (PDF, XLSX, CSV, ZIP...); not for sri_datasets, sri_recaudacion or censo.

tools.long_description: Searches one institution's catalog of published files and returns direct links (title, URL, format), not contents. Sources: sri_datasets, sri_recaudacion, mef, senae, censo, minedec, senescyt, msp, cnig, trabajo_boletin, salarios, arcotel_boletines and arcotel_mensuales. Download with download_resource or read_pdf (5 MB cap).

tools.name: list_archivo_secciones
tools.description: Sections of one institution's document archive (ARCSA, Superbancos, SEPS, INEVAL, SGR, SENESCYT, SIPA).

params.name: fuente
params.description: One of arcsa, superbancos, seps, ineval, sgr, senescyt, sipa.

tools.long_description: Lists the sections of one institution's document archive: the ARCSA sanitary registry, Superbancos and SEPS statistics, INEVAL evaluation datasets, SGR and Higher Education libraries, or SIPA agricultural statistics. Next: get_archivo_seccion(fuente, seccion).

tools.name: get_archivo_seccion
tools.description: Downloadable files of one section of a document archive (title, URL, format).

params.name: fuente
params.description: One of arcsa, superbancos, seps, ineval, sgr, senescyt, sipa.

tools.long_description: Lists the files in one section returned by list_archivo_secciones. Each file has title, URL and format, plus source-specific context (group, period, subgroup, description). Returns links, not contents; download large files directly (the preview and download tools cap at 5 MB).

tools.name: list_catalogo
tools.description: List one source's catalog that has no search filters: ARCONEL, BCE daily indicators, Contraloría, IESS or SUT.

params.name: fuente
params.description: Catalog to list: arconel, bce_diarios, contraloria, iess or sut.

tools.long_description: List the catalog of one source that has no filters, the step before its get tool. arconel: electricity report types by section, years (1998 on) and company groups; then get_arconel_reporte. bce_diarios: BCE daily/monthly indicator widgets outside BCEData (daily riesgo país since 2004, gold, WTI, bonds, payments, reserves, fiscal and external series); a codigo only means one thing within its archivo; then get_bce_indicador_diario(archivo, codigo). contraloria: quarterly CSVs of approved audit reports and annual control plans; then get_contraloria_informe. iess: IESS document collections (statistical bulletins, actuarial studies, audit reports) with years and counts; then get_iess_archivos(coleccion, anio). sut: Ministerio del Trabajo Power BI dashboards (contracts since 2015, labor demand, gender policy); then get_sut_indicador_schema and query_sut_indicador.

tools.name: search_capas_geo
tools.description: Layers of the INAMHI and MAG geoportals (rainfall, land cover, agricultural zoning).

params.name: query
params.description: Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the layer's id, name, title or abstract. Empty returns all layers.

params.name: solo_wfs
params.description: Only return layers with WFS (attribute data).

params.name: categoria
params.description: Only for fuente="mag": one of its 8 categories. Ignored for inamhi.

tools.long_description: Searches the layer catalog (WMS/WFS) of one GeoServer geoportal: inamhi (rainfall normals and anomalies, WRF forecast grids, watersheds) or mag (agro zoning, land cover, agricultural censuses, rural cadastre, agroclimatic risk). solo_wfs=true keeps layers with attribute data.

tools.name: get_capa_geo_datos
tools.description: Attribute sample (up to 20 features) from a WFS-enabled layer.

params.name: capa
params.description: The layer's `capa` from search_capas_geo (INAMHI: "geonode:..." name; MAG: "categoria/store/name").

params.name: count
params.description: Number of features to fetch (1-20, default 5).

tools.long_description: Fetches a small sample of a geoportal layer's feature attributes (capa from search_capas_geo) using WFS GetFeature. A preview, not a spatial query: no bbox or filters, and geometry coordinates are dropped. Layers without WFS (rasters, some MAG stores) raise an error.
